name: Atlas 800I A2 Inference Server - Technical Specifications
notes: PRIMARY VENDOR SOURCE. 4U, 8 NPUs, max 350 W per NPU module, PCIe 4.0 x16 per NPU with 'total bidirectional interconnection bandwidth between four CPUs and eight NPUs is 512 GB/s'. Network is 'Connected directly through 200GE QSFP ports, RoCE protocol'. Ships in 32 GB HCCS / 32 GB PCIe / 64 GB HCCS NPU variants, PCI ID 0x19E5:0xD802. Notably Huawei publishes the host-side interconnect budget but no chip-to-chip HCCS figure for this generation.
